name: new-lab
description: Design, implement, review and verify a new LabKit lab from one brief.

branches.prompt: Review the new lab against .kiro/specs/{{lab_name}}/requirements.md and the steering rules. Report blocking items with the REQ number they break. Do not modify any file.

Review the code just written for app-{{lab_name}}/: look for real bugs, missing guards, unstable behaviour and violations of the 'no DOM in laws' rule. Report findings with file and line. Do not modify any file.
